text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her new rival, Tokai Teio. Mihono Bourbon 
studies her history of glory and setbacks 
through past race footage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Word was that Tokai Teio was currently 
working on her comeback. Feeling worried, 
but wanting some fresh air, a trip to the 
track revealed—Tokai Teio right there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There was no need to worry. Seeing her 
train fiercely without a hint of 
discouragement actually gave me courage 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reminded anew of how amazing Tokai Teio is 
for being able to inspire courage, Mihono 
Bourbon applied herself to training even 
more diligently.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Tokai Teio had also witnessed 
Mihono Bourbon's success and came to see 
her as a rival.
